verdict.rationale: Asana's docs mention a broader integration ecosystem (App Directory apps, app components that 'plug directly into Asana UI', APIs/webhooks for building integrations), implying that tools can connect natively, but no evidence explicitly names Slack, GitHub, or Google Drive as first-party native integrations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of native Slack/GitHub/Google Drive connectors, hands-on confirmation of their functionality, and any independent corroboration of these specific integrations working out-of-the-box.
